sessions.title: Fix the broken pricing page links

messages.text: The pricing links 404 on mobile. Find out why and fix it.

Found it: the mobile menu builds links with a trailing slash, so `/pricing/` misses the route. I switched it to the shared route helper:

```tsx
<Link href={routes.pricing}>Pricing</Link>
```

The nav tests pass. Running the full suite now.
